description: Test helper code for setting up and managing Mattermost server components and test environment, including user, team, channel, and role management functions.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper class for setting up and managing test environment, including user, team, channel, post, and role management functions.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Initializes test environment with server, configuration, and optional enterprise features.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up test environment with default store and configuration.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Sets up test environment with custom configuration updates.

methods.name: initBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic user, team, channel, and post setup for tests.

methods.name: createUserOrGuest
methods.description: Creates a user or guest based on parameter.

methods.name: CreateChannel
methods.description: Creates a new channel in a team.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Internal method to create a channel with options.

methods.name: createChannelWithAnotherUser
methods.description: Creates a channel with a specific user as creator.

methods.name: createDmChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel with a user.

methods.name: createGroupChannel
methods.description: Creates a group channel with multiple users.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Creates a post in a channel.

methods.name: linkUserToTeam
methods.description: Links a user to a team.

methods.name: addUserToChannel
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel.

methods.name: removePermissionFromRole
methods.description: Removes a permission from a role.

methods.name: addPermissionToRole
methods.description: Adds a permission to a role.
